counterfactual.change: set sensor_noise from 0.017035943934549849 to 0 to remove measurement noise; all other fields identical. This removes controller misestimation and failure disappears.

explanation: With dt~0.02 and sensor_noise~0.017 at near-max, the state-feedback controller receives noisy theta/omega measurements. Starting theta=0.1, it applies incorrect forces up to 24N, pumping energy from 1.28J to 17J. Pole diverges: theta goes 0.034 at step5, -0.257 at step10, -0.724 at step14, -0.867 at step15 violating 0.8 limit. Removing only noise makes same plant stable with no violation, proving noise-induced misestimation + coarse integration is cause.
vision_note: From steps 12 to 14 the pole tilts progressively further from upright while the cart drifts right, with the orange tip moving leftward away from vertical. At step 15 the tip turns red as the pole angle exceeds the 0.8 rad upright limit, showing a loss of balance.
